title: What Ten Years With One Subject Can Teach You
excerpt: Ivan McClellan first encountered Black rodeo culture in Oklahoma in 2015. A decade of returning built the relationships behind Eight Seconds: Legacy in Motion, a book of more than 90 previously unpublished photographs.

title: Depth Is Not the Blur
excerpt: Max Kent calls a wide aperture the lazy version of depth. His case: soft light from roughly 45 degrees above and to the side, plus a clear foreground, midground, and background, build separation that survives even at f/8.

title: Sigma Is Selling Character Now, Not Just Sharpness
excerpt: Sigma's 50mm F1.4 CL DG Contemporary is the first in a new CL line: 65mm long, 375 grams, aluminum body, and soft corners by design. It arrives in early spring 2027 for L and Sony E mounts, with no price announced yet.
